title: 完全平方数
statement: 给定正整数 n，把它表示成若干个完全平方数（1, 4, 9, 16, …，可重复使用）之和，求所需完全平方数的最少个数。

en.title: Perfect Squares
en.statement: Given a positive integer n, express it as a sum of perfect squares (1, 4, 9, 16, …, each may be used repeatedly) and find the minimum number of perfect squares needed.

complexity.notes: n is the input integer. dp[i] = 1 + min(dp[i - j²]). Using Lagrange's four-square theorem and Legendre's three-square theorem gives O(√n): the answer can only be 1–4, and it is 4 when n has the form 4^a(8b+7).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: one line with integer n. stdout: one integer, the minimum count.

complexity.time: O(n√n)（本地训练目标，动态规划）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为输入整数。dp[i] = 1 + min(dp[i - j²])。利用四平方和定理与 Legendre 三平方和定理可做到 O(√n)：答案只可能是 1~4，n 形如 4^a(8b+7) 时为 4。
